confluences.description: The trade must be initiated at 9:30 AM ET New York time.

entry_sequence.action: At 9:30 AM ET, define the initial range by marking the high and low of the first 5-minute candle.
entry_sequence.rationale: This establishes the initial volatility range for the trading session.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for the 1-minute candle to close outside of the 5-minute range (breakout).
entry_sequence.rationale: The breakout gives an idea of the direction the market wants to go: a downside break is taken short, an upside break is taken as a buy.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for a fair value gap sequence to print outside the range.
entry_sequence.rationale: The FVG provides a high-probability entry point after the initial directional breakout.

entry_sequence.action: Enter the trade (long or short) on the closure of the third candle of the FVG sequence.
entry_sequence.rationale: The fair value gap sequence is valid once its third candle has been printed.

stop.rationale: The stop is placed at the bottom of the FVG candle, including the wick, to allow room for breathing.

targets.rationale: The strategy uses a fixed mechanical target based on a 2R risk-to-reward ratio.
